[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Balanced Remainders** [CF 1490B · Balanced Remainders](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/1490/B){rating="1000"}

Only the **residues modulo 3** matter - the actual values are irrelevant. An increment moves
an element one step around a $3$-cycle of buckets: $0 \to 1 \to 2 \to 0$. So the problem is
a pure histogram rebalancing: buckets above $n/3$ have surplus that must be pushed forward
to the under-full buckets behind them. Because a move only ever carries an element
*forward* one bucket, the optimal strategy is greedy - pass each bucket's surplus to its
successor - and it needs no search. This is the residue-histogram device of @sec-gcd-a3 at
its simplest.

[Solved in full in @sec-gcd-p4-balance.]{.card-link}

:::
